article: メインPCのスペックメモ（2022年9月時点）
scope: Compared the complete Japanese specification table and all twelve translations; checked component names, memory, system type, Windows version/build, descriptions, dates, and official references.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, retained the original publication date 2022-09-08, and recorded lastmod 2026-11-24 in all locales.
Changed titles and descriptions to make clear this is a September 2022 snapshot rather than the current PC configuration.
Intel identifies 3.70 GHz as the Core i7-8700K base frequency; the processor can boost up to 4.70 GHz.
Microsoft release information lists Windows 11 build 22000.856 in the August 9, 2022 update entry.
Added official Intel and Microsoft references to each locale.

post/今のメインPCスペック/index.en.md.summary: Reviewed the full translated hardware inventory against Japanese and official Intel/Microsoft references, clarified that the configuration is a historical snapshot, and aligned the description with the recorded date.

meaning.note: Compared the full system-spec table and description across locales. Preserved the personal device snapshot and explicitly dated it September 8, 2022 so “current PC” is not read as a claim about the present day.

terminology.note: Checked CPU model, base-frequency terminology, memory amount, x64 system type, Windows 11 Enterprise, version 21H2/build 22000.856, and manufacturer name.

mathematics.note: The hardware inventory contains no mathematical formulas or calculations.

code.note: The hardware inventory contains no code or commands.

links.note: Added official Intel processor specifications and Microsoft Windows 11 release information; verified the 3.70 GHz base frequency and the 22000.856 release entry.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
